objects.name: Detection technique coverage: linux-auditd-base64-decode-files
objects.description: The following analytic detects suspicious Base64 decode operations that may indicate malicious activity, such as data exfiltration or execution of encoded commands. Base64 is commonly used to encode data for safe transmission, but attackers may abuse it to conceal malicious payloads. This detection focuses on identifying unusual or unexpected Base64 decoding processes, particularly when associated with critical files or directories.
